name: Urethane Supply Company Mini-Weld Model 7 Plastic Welder - 120 Volt, 200 Watt, Model 7
description: The Mini-Weld Model 7 Plastic Welder is a 120V, 200 Watt highly portable airless plastic welder that is ideal for making quality repairs to virtually any type of plastic, including TPO and polypropylene. Ideal for use on plastic bumpers, headlight housings, overflow bottles, nylon radiator tanks and other automotive plastics. U.S.A. Color Red case, Compatible With 8 types of plastic welding rods, Control Box Included Yes, Dimensions L x W x H in. 14 x 12 x 5, Material Type Plastic, Max. Temperature F 850, Single, Pair, or System Single, Typical Application Plastic welding/repair, Volts 120, Watts 200, Welding Rod Type Plastic, most 1/8 in. dia. Variable temperature, ceramic-core welder Belt clip equipped control unit for easy and convenient temperature adjustments 850F max. temperature Kit contains polyurethane, polypropylene, ABS, polyethylene, TPO, nylon, polycarbonate and FiberFlex universal welding rods Includes a ceramic-core heating element, 2 welding tips, reinforcing mesh, stainless wire brush and instructional DVD in a molded storage case Model Number: 5700HT. Age Group: adult.
